sources.name: PhiUSIIL (UCI 967)
sources.collection: URL/website tabular dataset and documented class-label convention
sources.label_policy: official label 1 is legitimate and 0 is phishing; CER mapping is the exact inverse (0 benign, 1 phishing)
sources.access_gate: retain the UCI release hash, citation and CC BY 4.0 attribution; preserve the existing local prepared CSV with its transformation manifest
sources.time_policy: static release/import time is not webpage capture, source availability, or first-seen time

sources.name: PhishTank
sources.collection: verified phishing URLs, submission/verification timestamps, target brand, online state
sources.label_policy: verified records may assert phishing; pending/absent records are unknown, never benign
sources.access_gate: use descriptive User-Agent; register an application key for automated downloads; retain snapshot hash, retrieval time, response headers, and terms version
sources.time_policy: verification_time is a source event time; label_available_at is only the retained local snapshot receipt time

sources.name: PhishingEval
sources.collection: available HTML, screenshots, URL/brand reference data, failure cases, and controlled perturbation examples where released
sources.label_policy: preserve release labels and split semantics; do not mix visual/content artifacts with URL-only records without a release manifest
sources.access_gate: pin repository commit and every selected Zenodo dataset artifact hash; verify applicable dataset license and terms before acquisition
sources.time_policy: dataset artifact timestamps do not establish web first-seen time unless collection/availability provenance is provided

sources.name: Common Crawl
sources.collection: WARC/WAT/WET archived responses and observed crawler links
sources.label_policy: archive presence is unlabeled content evidence; it is neither benign nor phishing proof
sources.access_gate: record crawl ID, CDX/WARC record locator, WARC digest, fetch timestamp, HTTP metadata, and applicable access/usage terms; parse locally without executing page content
sources.time_policy: use record-level crawl/fetch time only when preserved; a crawl date alone is not decision-time availability

sources.name: Tranco
sources.collection: versioned popular-domain ranking and permanent list identifier
sources.purpose: candidate pool for independently screened benign observations
sources.label_policy: ranked domains are benign candidates only; require independent screening/observation before a benign label
sources.access_gate: retain list ID, retrieval time, Last-Modified header, source attribution and component-provider terms
sources.time_policy: list timestamp is ranking availability, not website capture or benign-label time

sources.name: PhiShark 2026
sources.collection: scan metadata plus available HTML, screenshots, DNS/TLS/redirect/hosting evidence
sources.label_policy: use release labels and explicit artifact availability; missing artifact remains missing
sources.access_gate: restricted academic/nonprofit access: manual approval, signed Data Use Agreement, non-commercial use and no redistribution; retain approval/DUA and release hashes
sources.time_policy: use supplied scan timestamps only with documented semantics; never infer missing capture/availability time

global_rules: A registry entry is not an acquired dataset.
No live crawling, form submission, content execution, or contact with observed targets.
Every acquired snapshot needs immutable bytes, SHA-256, receipt time, source/release identifier, and access-terms record.
Feeds and popularity lists are not benign labels by absence or rank.
Independent-source ancestry must be documented before robustness claims.
